build_audio_encoder: build a Python module to encode 16kHz audio into latent embeddings using AudioEncoder with mel-spectrogram and dilated convolutions
build_expression_encoder: build a Python module to encode face mesh geometries into latent expression embeddings using ExpressionEncoder with an LSTM
build_fusion_mlp: build a Python module to fuse expression and audio codes into categorical logprobs using FusionMlp with Gumbel softmax heads
build_multimodal_encoder: build a Python module to jointly encode face geometry and audio into fused categorical logprobs using MultimodalEncoder
test_multimodal_encoder_forward: test the MultimodalEncoder forward pass with face geometry and audio tensors to verify logprobs output
